description: Defines the TaxGroupMappings entity class for tax group and component associations with date ranges in the Fineract project.

classes.name: TaxGroupMappings
classes.description: Entity class representing mappings between tax groups and tax components with effective date ranges.

methods.name: createTaxGroupMappings
methods.description: Factory method to create a TaxGroupMappings instance with a start date and null end date.

methods.name: createTaxGroupMappings
methods.description: Factory method to create a TaxGroupMappings instance with an ID, tax component, and end date.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the end date of the mapping and records the change if applicable.

methods.name: occursOnDayFromAndUpToAndIncluding
methods.description: Checks if a given date falls within the mapping's date range.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the mapping.

methods.name: startDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the mapping.

methods.name: endDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the mapping.

methods.name: setTaxGroup
methods.description: Sets the TaxGroup for this mapping.
